Admissions

Your journey starts here.

How to Apply

We are excited to welcome new students to Ocean Mountain Academy. Our admissions process is designed to identify passionate and driven individuals who will thrive in our unique academic environment.

Application Steps:

  1. Complete the online application form.
  2. Submit required academic transcripts and standardized test scores.
  3. Provide letters of recommendation.
  4. Participate in an interview (if required).
